answer: Rescue teams write down every callout, even the quiet ones. Proof of notary commission via state notarial register entry leaves the same trail: an entry the state register made when the notary was commissioned. The horizon of the trail is its weather - each entry carries its storm, and storms do not repeat on demand. Forging one callout needs a mountain and a bad night; a hundred need a hundred storms, and the pearl of each is the volunteer who climbed in the rain. The opal the gate checks is the roster, kept by people who were cold, wet, and there.
